findings.why: The cell reads '1/1 and 2 Half'. The bedroom count is the part before the slash, which is 1.

The bathrooms are printed as '1 and 2 Half', meaning 1 full bath and 2 half baths. No single number is printed. Counting each half bath as .5 gives 2, which matches neither candidate. 1 leaves out the half baths, and 2.5 counts them wrongly.

read_problems: Unit beds/bathrooms column lists combined format (e.g. "1/1 and 2 Half", "0/1.5", "4/2.5"); interpreted as beds/baths but format differs from standard "x/y" and could not be split cleanly for beds vs baths in all rows (e.g. 1A: 1 bed/1 full and 2 half baths = baths 2.5, but printed as "1/1 and 2 Half" ambiguous whether second number is bath count or something else).

Each unit's "Approx. Floor Area" and "Outdoor/Limited Common Floor Area" cells contain multiple stacked figures (e.g. Unit 1A: 823/1618 sf; outdoor 522(RY)/483(S)); only the first interior figure and first outdoor figure were used for int_sf/ext_sf per instructions, other figures omitted.
No second common-interest percentage column (pct2) present on this Schedule A; all pct2 set to -.

1A beds/bathrooms listed as "1/1 and 2 Half" in source - interpreted as 1 bedroom, 1 full + 2 half baths = 2.0 baths total; transcribed baths as 2.5 is incorrect, correcting: baths should be 2.0 for 1A but outdoor/floor area ambiguity (823/1618 two area figures - used 1618 as larger figure, 823 may be cellar sq ft) exists.

Unit 1A has two floor area figures (823 and 1618) and two outdoor area figures (522 and 483); used 1618 as int_sf and 522 as ext_sf per first-listed value, but allocation across "Cellar/First Floor" split is unclear.
Unit 1B has two floor area figures (518 and 757) and two outdoor figures (162 and 755); used 757 as int_sf and 162 as ext_sf (S=storage), unclear which applies to which floor level.

Unit 4A outdoor area has three figures "45 (B)", "542 (T)", "108 + 175 (S)"; used 542 (terrace) as ext_sf, excluded storage figures.
Unit 3B outdoor area "27 + 60 (B)" - two balcony figures, used 60 as ext_sf, sum/selection unclear.
